transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (1259x856) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 29/12/2012 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name '121229'. Height axis 2.7 px/cm, BUT the image is locally compressed between the 110 and 90 cm gridlines (46 px instead of 54; 100 gridline missing, '100' label cut), the same artefact as the other SnowPro screenshots of this batch. The 4F+/1F+ bar step lies exactly in that band (y429): read as 102 on the upper scale (in the 2012-11-22 chart the same row matched HS 102), could be 99-102 -> listed uncertain. Other boundaries 145/130/55/30/0 from bar edges and H-column leader lines (+-0.5 cm). Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F+ (2.5 px past F), 4F+ (6 px past 4F), 1F+ (13 px past 1F), P, K- (67 px past P, 5 px short of K-); R-column icons agree. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline); markers located with a ring detector. No marker at the surface: the dashed air segment (from -8.4 at the plot top) turns solid at the surface (~-9.7) and runs straight to the 135 cm marker; printed Surface Temp -11.9 kept in header notes only. The 100 cm value is a line kink inside the compressed band (marker cut away; height approximate). Markers every 10 cm to 50 cm, then 30 and 0 cm (0 cm half hidden under the bottom border). 'Nov 6 rain crust has faceted out' is free text naming no drawn crust layer; kept in header notes.
